conditions.label: Pregnancy
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor is pregnant and at least {param1}% through her pregnancy.

conditions.label: Ovulation
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor is ovulating.

conditions.label: Cycle Phase
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor is in the {param1} part of her cycle.

conditions.label: Baby Health
conditions.description: Triggers while the actor is pregnant and the baby is at least {param1}% healthy.

conditions.label: Birth Count
conditions.description: Triggers when the actor has given birth at least {param1} time(s) before.

effects.label: Trigger Ovulation
effects.description: Burst — forces the actor to start ovulating (does nothing if she is already pregnant).
